record.label: DMG Vol 14 Ch 84: Deemed weekly income from capital — 84001 — Introduction
record.scope: Frozen DMG dmg-vol14-ch84; captured role: substantive. Boundary: machine candidate, unresolved. A structural unit is not a complete legal rule or applicability decision. Capture dates are not effective dates. Check governing headings, definitions, exceptions and current source.
record.text:
Introduction 84001 - 84010

Introduction

84001 Chapter 84 gives guidance on how to work out for SPC the amount of deemed weekly income
from capital. The total of actual capital and notional capital is worked out before the amount of deemed
weekly income is worked out.
